summary.headline: H1 FY27 record EBITDA of INR1,326 crores (up ~4% YoY) and PAT of INR799 crores (up ~5%); Q2 EBITDA INR564 crores, PAT INR320 crores.
summary.overview: Management reported the highest-ever half-yearly EBITDA and PAT for H1 FY27, with total income of INR3,221 crores and cash profit of INR1,225 crores. In Q2, captive power operations were recalibrated to market conditions, supporting EBITDA of INR564 crores on total income of INR1,505 crores despite a 47-day shutdown of one 300 MW thermal unit and an 18-day Sikkim hydro outage. Management said energy contributed more than 75% of H1 EBITDA and that higher realisations in thermal and hydro drove profitability. The company entered manganese ore mining via preferred bidder status for the Avagudem block (Andhra Pradesh), and ratings were upgraded (SEML to AA from AA-; Sarda Metals & Alloys to AA- from A, CRISIL).

segments.name: Energy (thermal and hydro)
segments.commentary: Contributed more than 75% of H1 FY27 EBITDA. 600 MW thermal plant had a 47-day shutdown of one 300 MW unit in Q2; management expects H2 thermal profitability to be substantially higher. Hydro H2 profitability expected lower due to seasonality.

segments.name: Iron ore pellets (Raipur)
segments.commentary: Record H1 pellet output of 4,29,059 tons. Q2 realisation about INR9,800/ton, versus above INR10,000/ton in Q1. Management expects pellet output to remain broadly flat in H2.

segments.name: Ferro alloys / metals (steel billets, wire rods, flats)
segments.commentary: Billet and wire rod plants were not operated for part of Q2 as power was sold in the market. Management described flat steel as more buoyant than long products, with flat steel near INR75,000-77,000/ton and long products near INR54,000 in some Mumbai markets.

segments.name: Mining (coal and manganese)
segments.commentary: Shahpur West high-grade coal mine targeted for commissioning before end of FY27; Bartunga Hill expected by end of FY28. Avagudem manganese block (4,50,000 tons extractable reserves) won via auction; operations expected in 12-14 months.

guidance_outlook: Management gave no forward numerical guidance on revenue or EBITDA for FY27.
FY27 thermal generation expected to exceed 420 crore units; H1 generation was 202 crore units.
No major thermal shutdown expected for the rest of FY27; one 300 MW unit to be shut for 30-40 days in FY28.
Environmental clearance for 600 MW to 1,200 MW thermal expansion expected within FY27 after MoEF terms of reference.
Avagudem manganese mine expected to save INR200-400/ton on low-grade ore; start in 12-14 months, subject to approvals.
Management expects H2 FY27 power prices to be much better than H1 realisations.
Logistics and raw material cost pressure expected to ease in 2-3 months per management; next quarter described as unpredictable.
capex_capacity: Expansion of 600 MW thermal to 1,200 MW: terms of reference approved by MoEF; environmental clearance expected within FY27. Brownfield, funded from internal accruals.
50 MW captive solar project expected to be commissioned next quarter, subject to right-of-way issues on transmission line.

Three small hydro projects in Chhattisgarh (aggregate 74 MW) approvals progressing as scheduled. Recently acquired 66 MW hydro project in Arunachal Pradesh: key approvals in place, land acquired, approach road work started.
Replaced 3 MW turbogenerator at Raipur commenced operations in August 2026 at full capacity.
Gare Palma IV/5 and Senduri coal block regulatory approvals progressing as planned.
demand_pricing: Thermal: about 60% of saleable thermal power capacity tied up under contracts; spot realisation in Q2 about INR5.20-5.50/unit per management.
Hydro: all hydro projects tied up except Sikkim (113 MW), which the company is keeping on the spot market; Sikkim earned above INR6/unit over H1 on average.
National context per management: power generation up 11% YoY to about 536 billion units in the quarter; peak demand up 18% to 270 GW; solar generation up 39%.

Coking coal and freight costs rose sharply: bulk freight near USD36-38 versus usual USD18-22 per vessel, due to high crude prices and West Asia tensions. Indian mine output affected by monsoon flooding.
Iron ore pellet realisation: above INR10,000/ton in Q1 FY27, about INR9,800/ton in Q2.

qa_highlights.question: How will Avagudem manganese mine strengthen raw material integration, and when will cost benefits show?
qa_highlights.answer: Management said the mine (4,50,000 tons extractable reserves) would save about INR200-400/ton on low-grade ore, providing raw material security for four to five years. Start depends on paperwork; no investment figure disclosed.

qa_highlights.question: What was the revenue impact of the 300 MW shutdown in Q2?
qa_highlights.answer: CFO estimated lost revenue of about INR120-140 crores from the 300 MW unit shutdown in the quarter. Steel billet and wire rod plants were not run for part of the quarter because power was sold in the market.

qa_highlights.question: Will the thermal shutdown affect FY27 generation?
qa_highlights.answer: CFO said FY27 generation would exceed last year's, with no major shutdown planned for the rest of the year; one unit is expected to need a 30-40 day shutdown in FY28.

qa_highlights.question: What are realisations and tie-ups for H2?
qa_highlights.answer: Thermal realisation was about INR5.30/unit in Q2 and above INR6/unit for hydro. About 60% of saleable thermal capacity is tied up; H2 prices are expected to be better than H1.

qa_highlights.question: Can FY27 revenue exceed INR2,500 crores?
qa_highlights.answer: Management declined to give any numerical forward guidance, calling the question speculative.

qa_highlights.question: What were pellet realisations in Q1, Q2 and October?
qa_highlights.answer: Q1 pellet realisation was above INR10,000/ton and Q2 about INR9,800/ton; October figures were not given.

risks_watch: Raw material and logistics cost squeeze from high crude, freight costs and Australian coking coal prices; management expects easing in 2-3 months but next quarter is unpredictable.
Environmental clearance for the 600 MW to 1,200 MW expansion expected within FY27; timing not firm.
Avagudem manganese mine: approvals and start timing (12-14 months) still uncertain; costs not disclosed.
Sikkim hydro remains untied to contracts and is exposed to spot prices and seasonal rainfall (H2 hydro profitability guided lower).
Shahpur West coal mine commissioning targeted before FY27 year-end; Bartunga Hill by end FY28.
Investor perception of shutdown timing: a retail investor questioned the Q2 shutdown during peak-price months; management said it was intimated in the prior call.
summary.management_tone: Confident on H1 results and the energy franchise, but evasive on numbers: management declined any FY27 revenue or EBITDA guidance and gave only qualitative H2 views. Answers on shutdown timing and manganese mine investment were brief and deferred to "once we ascertain the realities on ground".
key_quotes: H1 FY27 marked the milestone for SEML, with the highest ever half yearly EBITDA of INR1,326 crores, up approximately 4% year-on-year and PAT of INR799 crores, up approximately 5%.
We remain net debt-free on both a standalone and a consolidated basis with liquidity exceeding INR2,600 crores as of 30th September 2026.
We don't give any forward guidance.
Energy's contribution of more than 75% of H1 EBITDA demonstrates its importance to our earnings profile.
